title: Free GTA VI via Twitch and Kick Launch Giveaways
description: Learn how Twitch and Kick are offering free GTA VI codes through launch promotions, including Kick's 10,000 Sunset Reward Case and Twitch's daily drops.
youtubeTitle: Free GTA VI Codes Available via Twitch and Kick Launch Promotions
socialHook: Kick is giving away 10,000 free GTA VI Ultimate Edition codes through its Sunset Reward Case.

sections.heading: Kick’s Sunset Reward Case Details
paragraphs: Kick’s Sunset Reward Case runs from November 19 to December 7, offering 10,000 digital GTA VI Ultimate Edition codes for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with PS5 codes restricted to supported PlayStation Network regions while Xbox codes are worldwide.

Viewers must watch any Kick stream for three consecutive hours to unlock a daily reward case, then open the case next to their avatar for a chance to win a game code, with a new case released each day and an extra free case for new users after onboarding.

sections.heading: Twitch Daily Code Drops and GTA Rewards
paragraphs: During TwitchCon San Diego 2026, Twitch announced daily GTA VI code drops from launch until the end of November, though the total number of codes and specific entry requirements remain undisclosed.

Twitch is also adding GTA-themed Sub Emotes, Badges, an evolving viewer badge for GTA stream watchers, and exclusive Heist Hype Train emotes for participating streams, enhancing the community experience.
